synonyms: Centurion, Centurion Plus, Chevron RE 45601, cletodime

136033680.name: Poly ICLC
136033680.description: Poly ICLC is an immunostimulant. It is polyinosinic-polycytidylic acid mixed with the stabilizers carboxymethylcellulose and polylysine.

146675088.name: MOTS-c
146675088.description: MOTS-c (mitochondrial open reading frame of the 12S rRNA-c) is a 16-amino-acid peptide that in humans is encoded by the mitochondrial MT-RNR1 gene, with the amino acid sequence MRWQEMGYIFYPRKLR.

156337168.name: LPH-5 (drug)
156337168.description: LPH-5, also known as -3-(2,5-dimethoxy-4- phenyl)piperidine or as -2C-TFM-3PIP, is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine, 2C, and 3-phenylpiperidine families which is under development for...

160796944.name: Lanthanum oxyfluoride
160796944.description: Lanthanum oxyfluoride is an inorganic compound of lanthanum, fluorine, and oxygen with the chemical formula LaOF.

162623504.name: Etoetonitazene
162623504.description: Etoetonitazene is a benzimidazole derivative with opioid effects, first developed in the 1950s as part of the research that led to better-known compounds such as etonitazene.

177206928.name: 4-Allyl-6-oxa-noribogainalog
177206928.description: 4-Allyl-6-oxa-noribogainalog is a κ-opioid receptor agonist of the oxa-ibogalog family related to oxa-noribogaine.

900000016.name: 2,3,4,6-Tetramethoxyamphetamine
900000016.description: 2,3,4,6-Tetramethoxyamphetamine , also known as TeMA-2, is a chemical compound of the phenethylamine and amphetamine families related to the psychedelic drug mescaline .

900000144.name: Americium nitride
900000144.description: Americium nitride is a binary inorganic compound of americium and nitride with the chemical formula AmN.

900000272.name: Berkelium(III) nitrate
900000272.description: Berkelium nitrate is the berkelium salt of nitric acid with the formula Bk 3.

900000400.name: Californium(IV) oxide
900000400.description: Californium oxide, also called californium dioxide, is a binary inorganic compound of californium and oxygen with the chemical formula CfO2.

900000528.name: Curium nitride
900000528.description: Curium nitride is a binary inorganic compound of curium and nitrogen with the chemical formula CmN.

900000656.name: Dusigitumab
900000656.description: Dusigitumab is a human monoclonal antibody designed for the treatment of cancer.

900000784.name: Ethylflualprazolam
900000784.description: Ethylflualprazolam is a benzodiazepine derivative which has been sold as a designer drug.

900000912.name: Guavanin 2
900000912.description: Guavanin 2 is a synthetic antimicrobial peptide designed using an algorithm to optimize the effectiveness of Pg-AMP1, a glycine-rich peptide found in the genome of guavas .

900001040.name: Iratumumab
900001040.description: Iratumumab is a human monoclonal antibody that was investigated for treating oncological diseases such as relapsed refractory CD30-positive lymphoma including Hodgkin's disease.

900001168.name: Lonapegsomatropin
900001168.description: Lonapegsomatropin, sold under the brand name Skytrofa, is a human growth hormone used for the treatment of growth hormone deficiency.

900001296.name: Mutacin 1140
900001296.description: Mutacin 1140 is a bacteriocin produced by Streptococcus mutans.

900001680.name: Ponsegromab
900001680.description: Ponsegromab is a monoclonal antibody that works as a GDF-15 inhibitor.

900001808.name: Rontalizumab
900001808.description: Rontalizumab is a humanized monoclonal antibody being developed by Genentech. As of November 2009, it is being investigated in a clinical trial for the treatment of systemic lupus erythematosus.

900002064.name: Tregalizumab
900002064.description: Tregalizumab is an immunomodulator. It is also known as BT-061. Tregalizumab binds to domain 2 of CD4, and activates Regulatory T cells .

900002192.name: Ytterbium dirhodium disilicide
900002192.description: Ytterbium dirhodium disilicide , also abbreviated YRS, is a heavy fermion solid state compound of ytterbium, rhodium and silicon.
